top.title: 4-in-1 Raspberry Pi HAT combines RTL-SDR, LoRa, GPS, and RTC
top.summary: Guangzhou-based HackerGadgets has launched a 4-in-1 Raspberry Pi HAT that offers RTL-SDR and LoRa connectivity, GPS and Beidou/GLONASS GNSS, and a PCF85063A real-time clock (RTC). The SDR part is implemented through an RTL2832U+R860 combo supporting 100 kHz to 1.74 GHz frequency and 100 kHz-28.8 MHz HF direct sampling. The HAT also features a Semtech SX1262 LoRa transceiver supporting the 860-960 MHz frequency band, 22 dBm max output power, and Meshtastic firmware. Users can select between U.FL and SMA versions depending on the type of antennas they plan to use. RTL-SDR/LoRa/GPS/RTC HAT specifications: Compatibility Raspberry Pi 3B, 4B, and 5 – Direct installation. Raspberry Pi Zero and Zero 2 W – Direct installation if the board has a 40-pin header; check overall height and power capacity. Software-defined radio (SDR) module Chips – Realtek RTL2832U + Rafael Micro R860 as used in many R
